modernopt.config.title: ModernOPT
modernopt.option.enabled.tooltip: Master switch for all ModernOPT render changes.
modernopt.option.renderScale.tooltip: Internal world resolution. Lower values render fewer pixels and upscale the result.
modernopt.option.upscaler.tooltip: Filter used to reconstruct the full-resolution image. FSR 2 adds temporal accumulation and works with Iris shader packs; MSAA is forced off.
modernopt.option.softness.tooltip: SoftScale blur strength: 0 is neutral, 100 is very soft.
modernopt.option.fsrEasuSharpness.toolti: EASU sharpening strength for FSR 1 and FSR 2: 0 is off, 100 is strong. Controls edge enhancement during upscaling.
modernopt.option.fsrRcasSharpness.toolti: RCAS sharpening strength for FSR 1 and FSR 2: 0 is off, 100 is strong. Applied after upscaling/temporal pass.
modernopt.option.msaa.tooltip: Multisample anti-aliasing for the world pass. Ignored while a shader pack is active.
modernopt.option.ssaa.tooltip: Render the world at 2x resolution and downsample. Overrides render scale and MSAA.
modernopt.option.fxaa.tooltip: Post-process edge smoothing on the final image.
modernopt.option.overlay.tooltip: Show FPS and the current internal resolution.
modernopt.sodium.open.tooltip: Render scale, upscaling, MSAA, FXAA and SSAA
